consent.title: Updated terms
consent.body: We updated the recording term and privacy policy. Please read and accept them to continue.

recording.title: Lesson recordings
recording.body: Lessons may be recorded and stay available for 6 months, only to those who attended. Recordings contain the students' image and voice and are deleted automatically after that period. Accepting this term is required to have an account.

data.title: Data we collect
data.body: Only what is needed: full name, e-mail, mobile phone, birth date and, if you want, your goal with English. The platform is only for people aged 18 or over.

sharing.title: Who we share it with
sharing.body: Your data is never shared with third parties other than the services needed for the platform to work (hosting, e-mail and storage). Some of these services, such as e-mail, may process data outside Brazil, with the adequate safeguards the LGPD requires.

storage.title: Security
storage.body: Passwords are only stored as a hash, access is checked on the server for every operation, and each student only sees their own data and their class group's.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.body: You can see and correct your data at any time and ask for your account to be deleted. Deletion is done by the administrator.

changes.title: Changes to this term
changes.body: If this text changes, you will need to accept the new version on your next access.
